'''Mike Gandy''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 1st at [[October 2000 Maryland tournament]] on 15 October 2000, according to Doug Faust's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1353">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-16-maryland-15-oct-00d1353/ maryland-15-oct-00], DeckTech (Doug "Phrim" Faust, 16 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-16-maryland-15-oct-00d1353/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
